accrediting_body.quote: Has graduated from a school of medicine accredited by the L.C.M.E., a school of osteopathy accredited by the A.O.A., a Canadian accredited school of medicine or has been certified by the E.C.F.M.G.;

exams.name: USMLE

exams.name: COMLEX
exams.notes: Alternative to USMLE for osteopathic physicians

exams.name: FLEX
exams.quote: Has successfully completed all three (3) parts of the USMLE, national boards, the FLEX, a board approved, state constructed licensing examination, the examination by the licentiate of the medical council of Canada or the COMLEX

interval_years.quote: A license to practice medicine, subject to annual renewal;

required.quote: accompanied by proof of compliance with and fulfillment of continuing medical education requirements of the board

period_years.quote: complete one (1) hour of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or the treatment of substance abuse disorders every two (2) years

value: 1 hour of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or the treatment of substance abuse disorders every two years (for licensees registered with the board of pharmacy to dispense a controlled substance)
topical_requirements.quote: The board shall require licensees who are registered with the board of pharmacy to dispense a controlled substance in this state to complete one (1) hour of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or the treatment of substance abuse disorders every two (2) years.

requirements.value: License may be granted through the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact or by meeting standard licensure requirements. Out-of-state physicians may also be brought in for consultation without a license if the in-state physician notifies the board.
requirements.quote: The board may grant a license to practice medicine in this state as provided in the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact or, under this article, to any applicant who demonstrates, to the board, that he:

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice medicine in this state without a license granted by the board, or as otherwise provided by law.

credential_type.quote: "License" means a license to practice medicine in this state issued by the board pursuant to this chapter;

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice medicine in this state without a license granted by the board, or as otherwise provided by law.

title_protection.quote: Attaches the title of M.D., D.O., P.A., physician, surgeon, osteopathic physician or osteopathic surgeon, doctor, physician assistant or any other words, letters or abbreviations or any combination thereof when used in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis or treatment of human disease or condition

scope_protection.quote: Any person engaged in the practice of medicine or aiding and abetting another in the practice of medicine without a license granted by the board is guilty of a misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or renewing a license by bribery, fraud, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Renewing, obtaining or attempting to obtain or renew a license by bribery, fraud or misrepresentation;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating another licensee or practicing under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonating another licensee or practicing medicine under a false or assumed name;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading statements about the licensee's skill or the efficacy of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making false or misleading statements regarding the licensee's skill or the efficacy or value of his treatment or remedy for a human disease, injury, deformity, ailment, pregnancy or delivery of infants;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use the licensee's diploma, license, or certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting or allowing any person to use his diploma, license or certificate of registration;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the practice of medicine in a misleading, false, or deceptive manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the practice of medicine in a misleading, false or deceptive manner;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee or claim for payment by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee or claim for payment of a fee by fraud or misrepresentation;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or any crime that is a felony under Wyoming law in any jurisdiction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by a person not licensed by the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of this chapter or other applicable law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate or assist in the violation of any provision of this chapter or any other applicable provision of law;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly prescribing or administering narcotic or scheduled drugs to a known abuser
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as permitted by law, repeatedly prescribing or administering, selling or supplying any drug legally classified as a narcotic, addicting or scheduled drug to a known abuser;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeatedly prescribing narcotic or scheduled drugs to a parent, spouse, child, or oneself
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeatedly prescribing, selling, supplying or administering any drug legally classified as a narcotic, addicting or scheduled drug to a parent, spouse or child of the applicant or licensee, or to himself;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presigning blank prescription forms
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presigning blank prescription forms;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to properly guard against the spread of contagious, infectious, or communicable diseases
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to properly guard against the spread of contagious, infectious or communicable diseases;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to appropriately supervise nonphysicians to whom medical responsibilities have been delegated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to appropriately supervise nonphysicians to whom the licensee has delegated medical responsibilities;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience or licensure;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating medical responsibilities beyond the scope of the specialty areas in which the licensee and the person are trained
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating medical responsibilities to a person who is unable to safely, skillfully and competently provide medical care to patients or that are beyond the scope of the specialty areas in which the licensee and the person are trained and experienced;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and consistent utilization of medical service or treatment that is inappropriate or unnecessary
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful and consistent utilization of medical service or treatment which is inappropriate or unnecessary;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Manifest incapacity to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A manifest incapacity to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Possession of a physical or mental disability that renders the practice of medicine unsafe
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Possession of any physical or mental disability including deterioration due to aging which renders the practice of medicine unsafe;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of a drug or intoxicant to a degree rendering the licensee unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of a drug or intoxicant to such a degree as to render the licensee unable to practice medicine or surgery with reasonable skill and safety to patients;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine below the applicable standard of care, regardless of causation or damage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine below the applicable standard of care, regardless of causation or damage;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to submit to an informal interview or mental, physical, or medical competency examination upon board request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to submit to an informal interview or a mental, physical or medical competency examination following a proper request by the board pursuant to W.S. 33-26-403;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report a personal injury claim as required by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report a personal injury claim as required by W.S. 33-26-409;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, probation, conditions, relinquishment, surrender, or revocation of a license in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension, probation, imposition of conditions or restrictions, relinquishment, surrender or revocation of a license to practice medicine in another jurisdiction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse action by a health care entity affecting clinical privileges for 30 or more consecutive days or resulting in surrender of privileges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action by a health care entity that: (A) Adversely affects clinical privileges for a period of thirty (30) or more consecutive days;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional or dishonorable conduct including failure to conform to standard of care, patient harm, deception, falsification of records, practicing outside expertise, harassment, sexual misconduct, and other specified acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional or dishonorable conduct not otherwise specified in this subsection, including but not limited to:

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to produce documents or information relevant to a board investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Upon proper request by the board, failure or refusal to produce documents or other information relevant to any investigation conducted by the board, whether the complaint is filed against the licensee or any other licensee;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any board rule or regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any board rule or regulation;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acquiring or attempting to acquire narcotic or scheduled drugs by fraud or deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acquiring or attempting or conspiring to acquire any drug classified as a narcotic, addicting or scheduled drug by fraud or deception;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Initially prescribing controlled substances via the Internet absent a documented physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Initially prescribing any controlled substance specified in W.S. 35-7-1016 through 35-7-1022 for any person through the Internet, the World Wide Web or a similar proprietary or common carrier electronic system absent a documented physician-patient relationship;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any final order, consent decree, or stipulation between the board and the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any final order, consent decree or stipulation between the board and the licensee;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Behavior toward a patient or others that exploits the licensee's position of trust, knowledge, emotions, or influence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any behavior by a licensee toward a patient, former patient, another licensee, an employee of a health care facility, an employee of the licensee or a relative or guardian of a patient that exploits the position of trust, knowledge, emotions or influence of the licensee;

definition_quote.value: Practicing medicine means any person who in any manner: (A) Advertises, holds out, or represents to the public that he is authorized to practice medicine in this state; or (B) Offers or undertakes to prevent, diagnose, correct or treat, in any manner, by any means, method or device, any human disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect or abnormal physical or mental condition, injury, deformity or ailment, including the management of pregnancy and parturition; or (C) Attaches the title of M.D., D.O., P.A., physician, surgeon, osteopathic physician or osteopathic surgeon...; or (D) Practices osteopathy; or (E) Offers or undertakes to prescribe, order, give or administer drugs which can only be obtained by prescription according to law; or (F) Renders a determination of medical necessity or appropriateness of proposed treatment.
definition_quote.quote: "Practicing medicine" means any person who in any manner:

value: prevention, diagnosis, correction, or treatment of human disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition
prescribing, ordering, giving, or administering prescription drugs
rendering determinations of medical necessity or appropriateness of proposed treatment
methods_authorized.quote: Offers or undertakes to prevent, diagnose, correct or treat, in any manner, by any means, method or device, any human disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect or abnormal physical or mental condition, injury, deformity or ailment, including the management of pregnancy and parturition

drug_authority.value: Licensees may prescribe, order, give, or administer drugs obtainable only by prescription; prescribing controlled substances via the Internet without a documented physician-patient relationship is prohibited
drug_authority.quote: Offers or undertakes to prescribe, order, give or administer drugs which can only be obtained by prescription according to law;

license_status_types.quote: the board may grant: (i) A license to practice medicine, subject to annual renewal; (ii) A temporary license to practice medicine...; (iii) A restricted or conditional license; (iv) An inactive license...; (v) A medical training license...; (vi) An emeritus license...; (vii) A volunteer license...; (viii) An administrative medicine license

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must be certified by the ECFMG. The 'Fifth pathway' is available for students who studied at a foreign medical school, completed all formal requirements except internship or social service, attained a satisfactory score on a screening exam, and passed the foreign medical graduate examination or USMLE steps 1 and 2.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Has graduated from a school of medicine accredited by the L.C.M.E., a school of osteopathy accredited by the A.O.A., a Canadian accredited school of medicine or has been certified by the E.C.F.M.G.;

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: has completed at least one (1) year of postgraduate training in an A.C.G.M.E, A.O.A. or R.C.P.S.C. accredited program

pain_management_education_required.quote: The board shall require licensees who are registered with the board of pharmacy to dispense a controlled substance in this state to complete one (1) hour of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or the treatment of substance abuse disorders every two (2) years.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Initially prescribing any controlled substance via the Internet, World Wide Web, or similar electronic system is prohibited absent a documented physician-patient relationship.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Initially prescribing any controlled substance specified in W.S. 35-7-1016 through 35-7-1022 for any person through the Internet, the World Wide Web or a similar proprietary or common carrier electronic system absent a documented physician-patient relationship;

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Adopt rules and regulations for the practice of telemedicine.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into on behalf of this state with all other states legally joining in the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The degree of collaboration shall be determined at the practice level, which may include decisions made by the employer, group, hospital service or the credentialing and privileging systems.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe schedule II, III, IV, or V drugs but may not prescribe schedule I drugs. They may also dispense prepackaged medications in rural clinics when pharmacy services are not physically available.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant shall not prescribe schedule I drugs as defined by W.S. 35-7-1013 through 35-7-1014. A physician assistant may prescribe schedule II, III, IV or V drugs as defined by W.S. 35-7-1015 through 35-7-1022.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Each licensee shall report to the board any personal injury or wrongful death claim made because of any alleged act, error or omission of the licensee. Failure to report the claim shall be grounds for disciplinary action by the board.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Each health care entity shall report: (i) Any action it takes against a licensee on the grounds that the licensee is impaired, or has engaged in conduct constituting a ground for disciplinary action in W.S. 33-26-402; (ii) Any action that: (A) Adversely affects the clinical privileges of a licensee for a period exceeding thirty (30) days;

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Participate in and contract with a program or programs to assist in the return to practice of licensees who have exhibited disruptive behaviors, substance dependence or abuse or are suffering from physical or mental impairment;

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The board may order a licensee to undergo one (1) or more mental, physical or medical competency examinations by examiners deemed appropriate by the board if it has reasonable cause to believe that the licensee may be impaired.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: An administrative medicine license for physicians not providing patient care, provided the qualifications for and the conditions of this license shall be established by rule.
